dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric reduction in body width from the maximum breadth at the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area with a localized specular highlight near the anterior-most tip.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse clusters of lower-intensity (darker grey) pixels distributed across the central and posterior dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between mottled darker patches and the lighter baseline skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Parallel linear contrast disruptions, consistent with rake marks, are visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of superficial linear markings on the posterior dorsal plane.
